designationHistory.indexText: Congress provided for Ste. Genevieve National Historical Park in Missouri by enacting sec. 7134 of the Energy and Natural Resources Act of 2017 through the Consolidated Appropriations Act, 2018.

authority.citation: Public Law 115-141, div. G, sec. 121(a)(2), 132 Stat. 661 (text of sec. 7134 at 132 Stat. 1225 appendix)

designationHistory.note: Enactment by reference: sec. 121(a)(2) enacted sec. 7134 of S. 1460 as placed on the Senate calendar. The site name in the statute is spelled 'Ste. Genevieve'; NPS now writes 'Ste. Geneviève'.

sources.name: Federal Register notice, Ste. Genevieve National Historical Park, 85 FR 78357 (govinfo)

designationHistory.indexText: The Secretary of the Interior established Ste. Genevieve National Historical Park once enough land and partner agreements were in place.

authority.citation: Secretarial decision memorandum (effective Oct. 30, 2020); notice, 85 FR 78357 (Dec. 4, 2020)

sources.name: NPS History Collection, Ste. Geneviève NHP (Oct. 30, 2020)
